newsitem.title: BELGIUM: World steel output up three percent in March -IISI.
newsitem.headline: World steel output up three percent in March -IISI.

text.p: World crude steel output rose three percent year-on-year in March on the back of higher production figures in Asia as well as in North and South America, the International Iron and Steel Institute said on Monday.
Total crude steel production reported by 66 producing countries rose to 65.1 million tonnes from 63.2 million in the same 1996 month.
Output continued to rise in Asia, up by four percent to 24 million tonnes. However, production in China fell by 2.4 percent to 8.3 million tonnes and by 1.4 percent to 1.9 million tonnes in India.

North American output was up 3.1 percent to 11.1 million tonnes and U.S. production rose 3.2 percent to 8.5 million tonnes. Overall production in South America increased six percent to 3.2 million tonnes.
Western Europe's output firmed 2.4 percent to 14.8 million tonnes.
In the major steel producing countries in the region, output jumped 8.3 percent to 1.7 million tonnes in France and by 4.3 percent in Germany to 3.75 million tonnes.
However, it fell in Italy and Spain, by eight and 7.6 percent respectively.
